relations.text: 水処理の合弁会社を統合してできたウォーターブリッジの株式を、約14%持っている
relations.text_en: Devon holds about 14% of the equity of WaterBridge, formed by combining the produced water joint venture with other companies

source.label: Devon Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Devon received approximately 14 % of the equity interests in WaterBridge in connection with these transactions.

companies.name: カタリスト・ミッドストリーム・パートナーズ

relations.text: デラウェア盆地のステートライン地区で集積と処理の設備を整える合弁会社を、共同で持っている
relations.text_en: Devon has an interest in Catalyst, a joint venture to develop oil gathering and natural gas processing infrastructure in the Stateline area of the Delaware Basin

source.label: Devon Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Devon has an interest in Catalyst, which is a joint venture with an affiliate of Howard Energy Partners, LLC (“HEP”), to develop oil gathering and natural gas processing infrastructure in the Stateline area of the Delaware Basin.

relations.text: ステートライン地区の産出分を、固定料金の集積・処理契約でカタリストに委ねている
relations.text_en: Devon production from 50,000 net acres in the Stateline area is dedicated to Catalyst under fixed-fee gathering and processing agreements

source.label: Devon Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Through 2038, Devon’s production from 50,000 net acres in the Stateline area of the Delaware Basin has been dedicated to Catalyst subject to fixed-fee oil gathering and natural gas processing agreements.

companies.name: ハワード・エナジー・パートナーズ

relations.text: カタリストの合弁相手は、ハワード・エナジー・パートナーズの関連会社である
relations.text_en: The Catalyst joint venture partner is an affiliate of Howard Energy Partners

source.label: Devon Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Devon has an interest in Catalyst, which is a joint venture with an affiliate of Howard Energy Partners, LLC (“HEP”), to develop oil gathering and natural gas processing infrastructure in the Stateline area of the Delaware Basin.

relations.text: 地熱井でエネルギーをつくるファーボに、2024年に約1億1,700万ドルを出資している
relations.text_en: Devon invested approximately $117 million in Fervo, a geothermal energy company, in 2024

source.label: Devon Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2024, Devon invested approximately $ 117 million in Fervo, a company that generates energy from geothermal wells.
